blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The United States wants the Philippine government to resolve issues related to the controversial Pax Silica initiative first before proceeding with an agreement, according to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian. He said US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told him that the Philippines should be given enough time to address the various concerns surrounding the initiative. “He said he knows there are many issues and problems. We should not rush things and should give the Philippine government time to address these issues,” Gatchalian said in an interview with radio dzBB on Sunday, recounting the conversation he had with Rubio […]...
